invariants: The manipulated model and the mathematical relationship for shapes any way must stay consistent.
misconceptions: Changing a visible feature without preserving the relationship that defines shapes any way.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: What change would make the model stop representing the same mathematical relationship?

explanationVariants: Turning, flipping, and resizing EVENLY never change a shape's name. But stretching one side without the other can turn a square into a rectangle — or squeeze a rectangle into a square.
A shape keeps its name through any turn, flip, or even resize. Only an UNEVEN stretch or squeeze — one that breaks the equal sides or makes them equal — actually changes which shape it is.

widget.prompt: Most of these shapes were only turned, flipped, or resized evenly — same name. A couple were stretched or squeezed UNEVENLY, so they truly became a different shape. Sort each one by what it really is now.

items.label: a triangle flipped upside down
items.feedback: Flipping keeps all 3 straight sides — still a triangle.

items.label: a square turned so a corner points up
items.feedback: Turning keeps all 4 sides equal — still a square, only rotated.

items.label: a rectangle shrunk evenly to a tiny size
items.feedback: Shrinking evenly keeps 2 long sides and 2 short sides — still a rectangle.

items.label: a circle grown much bigger
items.feedback: Growing keeps it round all the way around — still a circle.

items.label: a square stretched wider without getting any taller, so its sides are no longer all equal
items.feedback: Once the sides are not all equal anymore, it is not a square — 2 longer sides and 2 shorter sides make it a rectangle now.

items.label: a rectangle squeezed narrower until all 4 sides match exactly
items.feedback: Once every side matches exactly, it is not a rectangle anymore — 4 equal sides make it a square now.

widget.missFeedback: Ask: did this shape only turn, flip, or resize evenly (same name), or did one side stretch or squeeze without the other (new name)?
widget.successFeedback: Yes — turning, flipping, and even resizing keep a shape's name, but an uneven stretch or squeeze can truly change it.

hints: Turning, flipping, and resizing EVENLY keep a shape's name the same.
Stretching or squeezing only ONE direction changes how many sides match — check the sides again.
If all 4 sides end up equal, it is a square now; if 2 are long and 2 are short, it is a rectangle now.
